nodes.name: Barracks & Guard
nodes.offers: Build a Barracks and hire Guards who patrol, answer the alarm and fight beside you.
details: Barracks plan (2 beds) + Guard emblem (3 Coins, 2 iron)
Every guard already uses the full moveset: light, telegraphed heavy, 3-hit combo and shield bash
Well-fed guards regenerate health
nodes.flavor: Every village needs someone awake at night.

nodes.name: Guard Drill
nodes.offers: Guards spar in pairs each morning after the night watch and earn +15% combat XP.
details: Morning drill, 07:00-08:48: the Guards just off the night watch spar in pairs in front of the Barracks: combos, feints, parries and ripostes, circling and pressing footwork; practice blows only (no damage); an odd Guard shadow-drills
A day-watch Guard joins only to make a pair and never the last one on watch; any alarm or raid ends the drill at once; no drill in rain
Each morning of drill trains Strength (rank) and gives 4 combat XP, up to the Trained tier
+15% Guard combat XP from real kills (stacks with Shield Wall to +40%)
nodes.flavor: Sweat in the yard saves blood at the gate.
depends_on: GuardDrillGoal: morning drill with its own practice clips (no damage)

nodes.gate_text: 1 Courier-delivered weapon to a Guard (a proof milestone, no Coins)
nodes.name: Watchtower & Archers
nodes.offers: Build a Watchtower, hire Archers, and post Guards on the tower.
details: Watchtower plan (banner, 4 ladders) + Archer emblem (3 Coins, 4 arrows)
Tower Post orders for Guards
Couriers keep tower archers stocked with real arrows
nodes.flavor: From the tower you see them before they see you.

nodes.name: Captain's Voice
nodes.offers: Your captain's voice carries: orders reach soldiers up to 80 blocks away instead of 48, raid orders hold 60 seconds after the raid instead of 30, and every order sounds a horn that rallies the listeners (+10% speed for 10 seconds).
details: The command keys stay free for everyone; this node makes them stronger
Earshot: 48 -> 80 blocks
Orders given during a raid or alarm hold 60 s after it ends (was 30 s)
Each order blows a horn (at most once every 3 s) and every soldier who heard it moves 10% faster for 10 s
nodes.flavor: One shout, and they turn as one.
depends_on: Guard control (per-role keys) - being built now

nodes.name: Raise the Barricades
nodes.offers: When a raid is spotted, every Builder drops other work to raise your marked barricades first, and barricade lines may be twice as long.
details: Barricade lines: up to 10 blocks instead of 5
When a raid is spotted, a Builder working on anything else drops it and raises a waiting barricade first (one Builder per barricade site)
Rushed barricades are built at night too
nodes.flavor: Carts on their sides, stakes in the mud: it will do till morning.
depends_on: Warning-time build order
Barricade block (Builder lane)

nodes.name: Defense Plans
nodes.offers: Draw a defense line on the ground and your Builder raises palisade walls, gates and a timber watchtower along it.
details: Defense Plan line tool: mark a wall line; the Builder builds palisade segments along it from your stores
Palisade gates and a timber watchtower blueprint
Each wall block is tagged with its segment kind (palisade, stone, gate) so raids can find weak points
Stone versions need Masonry
nodes.flavor: A line in the dirt today, a wall by the next new moon.
depends_on: Builder lane (being built now: PostRaidUpgrade wire 19)

nodes.name: Shield Wall
nodes.offers: Guards holding a line with a shield take 30% less damage from the front, and earn +25% combat XP.
details: +25% Guard combat XP, which stacks with Guard Drill
Give the Knights a line order (look at the ground, R): a guard standing on his spot with a shield takes -30% damage from blows in front of him
Blows from the flank or back are not reduced
Spearmen and Longswords are now their own nodes; old worlds that owned this node get both for free
nodes.flavor: Lock shields. Nobody steps back.
depends_on: Guard control (per-role keys) - being built now

nodes.name: Spearmen
nodes.offers: A new battle role: Spearmen fight from the second rank with long reach and brace against charges.
details: Pike Yard plan + Spearman emblem
Old worlds that owned Shield Wall get this node for free
nodes.flavor: Keep them at the end of your spear and they cannot reach you.
depends_on: Battle roles lane (being built now; plan/BATTLE-ROLES.md)

nodes.name: Iron Arms Drill
nodes.offers: Veterans wear iron chest and legs, Sergeants full iron: one armour tier earlier.
details: Existing effect: GuardArms dresses Veteran and above in the next rank's kit
Every piece is still taken from the Armoury, a Warehouse or the Banner stores, never conjured
Pairs with the Armoury, which forges the iron
Gear: opens Gear Tier 2 (Plate: iron armour, crossbows) for Veteran guards, Sharpshooters and level-5 workers; any one of Iron Arms Drill, Armoury or Mine, Smelter & Smithy counts
nodes.flavor: Iron on the shoulders of those who earned it.

nodes.name: Longbows
nodes.offers: Archers shoot 2 blocks farther and draw their bows faster.
details: Range 18 -> 20 blocks, draw 20 -> 16 ticks (existing ArcherDrill)
Pairs with the ranged command key (G): look at an enemy and tap it, and every archer in earshot looses at it (this order works with or without the drill)
Pick one: Longbows or Crossbows
Saves that already own the drill keep it, and Crossbows stay locked for them
nodes.flavor: Yew, patience, and forty arrows in the air at once.
depends_on: Guard control (per-role keys) for the Volley

nodes.name: Crossbows
nodes.offers: Archers switch to heavy bolts: each shot takes 50% longer to draw, but every hit does 40% more damage.
details: Draw time x1.5 (a 20-tick draw becomes 30)
+40% damage on every arrow that hits
The shot sounds like a crossbow
Pick one: Longbow Drill or Crossbows
nodes.flavor: Any farmhand can learn it in a week. That is the point.
depends_on: Crossbow branch in ArcherAttackGoal + animation

nodes.name: Armoury & Armourer
nodes.offers: An Armourer forges armour and shields for your guards from village iron and leather.
details: Armoury plan + Armourer emblem
Makes leather armour, iron armour and shields from stored goods (these Production recipes already exist)
Guards dress from the Armoury first, then the Warehouse
Gear can still be crafted by players or bought
Gear: opens Gear Tier 2 (Plate: iron armour, crossbows) for Veteran guards, Sharpshooters and level-5 workers; any one of Iron Arms Drill, Armoury or Mine, Smelter & Smithy counts
nodes.flavor: A guard is only as good as the steel the village gives him.
depends_on: Armourer emblem entry + release GameTests

nodes.name: Watchfires & Great Bell
nodes.offers: When the alarm sounds, villagers run for shelter 25% faster.
details: While the alarm is on, villagers run to shelter 25% faster
nodes.flavor: Smoke on the ridge - ring it, ring it now!
depends_on: Scout-warning timer (owner decision: ~1 in-game hour, earlier with a better watch)

nodes.name: Manned Palisade
nodes.offers: Your palisade becomes a fighting wall: raiders need twice as many blows to break a palisade segment.
details: A raider needs 12 blows instead of 6 to break a block of a palisade line your Builder raised
Gates are unchanged: they stay the way in
Pick one: Palisade or Ditch & Stakes
nodes.flavor: Sharpened oak, shoulder to shoulder, all the way round.
depends_on: Walls & gates slice
Raider weak-point pathing

nodes.name: Ditch & Stakes
nodes.offers: Raiders within 3 blocks of your built defense lines are slowed (Slowness II, 30% slower).
details: Works along every defense line your Builder raised: palisade, stone and barricades
The slow is refreshed every second while a raider stays near the line
Pick one: Palisade or Ditch & Stakes
nodes.flavor: Let them come. Let them come slowly.
depends_on: Work-zone dig task
Stake block (slow + damage)

nodes.gate_text: Own Manned Palisade or Ditch & Stakes
nodes.name: Stone Walls & Arrow Slits
nodes.offers: Stone wall segments take three times as many blows to break.
details: A raider needs 18 blows instead of 6 to break a block of a stone line your Builder raised
Gates are unchanged
nodes.flavor: What the axe cannot cut, the fire cannot eat.
depends_on: Walls & gates slice
Mason job loop

nodes.name: Veteran Techniques
nodes.offers: Guards master their moveset: the shield bash is ready 30% sooner, the combo window is 4 ticks longer, and heavy strikes hit 30% harder.
details: Shield bash cooldown 4 s -> 2.8 s
Combo window 6 -> 10 ticks
Heavy strike +30% damage
nodes.flavor: Watch the shoulder, not the blade.

nodes.name: Captain's Commission
nodes.offers: Your highest-ranked guard is field-promoted to Sergeant and commissioned Captain: bigger and stronger, a chosen weapon loadout with special attacks, and your soldiers salute him.
details: Learning it raises your top guard to at least Sergeant, once; with no guard yet, the first guard you hire gets the promotion
Later Captains must earn Sergeant the normal way
The Captain gets +16 health, +4 armour, +2 damage and resists knockback, and stands a little taller
Pick his weapon loadout; each loadout has its own special attacks
Guards salute their Captain
nodes.flavor: A banner, a title, and every eye on him when the horns sound.

nodes.name: Longswordsmen
nodes.offers: A new battle role: two-handed longswordsmen who break shields and cut through crowds.
details: Sword Hall plan + Longswordsman emblem
Old worlds that owned Shield Wall get this node for free
nodes.flavor: Two hands, one blade, and plenty of room around him.
depends_on: Battle roles lane (being built now; plan/BATTLE-ROLES.md)

nodes.name: Rune Mage
nodes.offers: A new battle role: a Rune Mage who spends rune charges on spells that turn a fight.
details: Rune Hall plan + Rune Mage emblem
Spells cost rune charges; a Ward lasts 5 s
Mage cap: 1 (2 with High Runes)
Old worlds that owned the Scholar doctrine get this node for free
nodes.flavor: Old words, cut into stone, and the stone remembers them.
depends_on: Battle roles lane (being built now; plan/BATTLE-ROLES.md)

nodes.name: Master Armoury
nodes.offers: Your guards and archers may wear diamond (Gear Tier 3, with the Castle Charter) and netherite (Gear Tier 4, with the Kingdom Crown).
details: Gear Tier 3 (Diamond) with the Castle Charter
Gear Tier 4 (Netherite) with the Kingdom Crown
Each soldier still needs the rank for the tier (rank AND village knowledge)
Unlocks the diamond and netherite weapon recipes (short sword, double axe, halberd, warhammer, longsword, spear)
nodes.flavor: Diamond is only a stone until a master knows where to strike it.
depends_on: Gear tiers (GearTier/GearGate built by the gear agent; resolves node:master_armoury)

nodes.name: High Runes
nodes.offers: Your mages master the high runes: a second Rune Mage may be hired, and wards last 6 seconds instead of 5.
details: Mage cap 1 -> 2
Ward lasts 6 s instead of 5 s
nodes.flavor: The high runes are not spoken. They are sung.
depends_on: Battle roles lane (being built now; plan/BATTLE-ROLES.md)

nodes.name: Order of Knights
nodes.offers: Order of Knights: your Sergeants and Captains fight as knights, +25% damage and no knockback.
details: Sergeant and Captain guards deal +25% melee damage
They cannot be knocked back
No horses yet
Pick one: Order of Knights or Pike Square
nodes.flavor: Hooves on the frost, lances down.

nodes.name: Pike Square
nodes.offers: Spearmen doctrine: braced Spearmen strike 50% harder and cannot be knocked back.
details: The brace strike does +50% damage
A braced Spearman cannot be knocked back
Pick one: Order of Knights or Pike Square
nodes.flavor: Ash shafts, iron heads, and not one step back.
depends_on: Battle roles lane (being built now; plan/BATTLE-ROLES.md)
Square formation

nodes.name: Masonry
nodes.offers: Your Builder learns stone: stone wall segments, a stone gatehouse, a stone watchtower, and stone floors in Upgrade Orders.
details: Builder can lay stone wall segments and a stone gatehouse along Defense Plan lines
Stone watchtower blueprint and stone variants of the starter blueprints
Upgrade Orders can lay stone or cobble floors (e.g. a Warehouse's 'solid floor'); plank floors work without Masonry
Unlocks no building level: levels stay checklist-only
nodes.flavor: Timber rots. Stone remembers.
depends_on: Builder lane (being built now: PostRaidUpgrade wire 20)

nodes.name: Battle Healers
nodes.offers: Hire Healers: they tend wounded soldiers in a fight and revive downed players.
details: Healer emblem
In a raid, Healers follow the line and tend the most wounded soldier nearby
A Healer near a downed player revives them
nodes.flavor: Hold still. You will live, and you will complain about it.
depends_on: Battle roles lane (being built now; plan/BATTLE-ROLES.md)
Downed state (roadmap phase 3) for carrying the fallen
